additionalImplementationModules.objective: Actual decoded 2D PNG/GIF with exact frame clock, bounded assets and persistent artifact later
Canonical ProjectRevision head + Timeline/Scene/Track/Clip mapping, one durable CAS writer
Bounded SI unit solver, deterministic output; do not call simulated data measurement
Valid GLB with versioned coordinate conversion and disclosed float32 losses
Decoded WAV/stem mixer, actual peaks and sourced A/B comparison
Real decodable video+audio+caption mux, exact PTS/digest and durable output
Issued reviewer case/version CAS; ACCEPT statement is not human approval
Authenticated actual destination checksum/ACK, durable lost ACK reconciliation
Rights-scoped translation, lawful voice, alignment and playable final audio
Trusted Media frame/ROI/PTS reader and public DI-only OCR
Scanner+artifact release decision, version-bound verified attestation and no untrusted release

journeys.behavior: Real sign-in/workspace/project revision; wrong tenant, duplicate create.
Real chunked upload/versioned artifact and corrupt/resume/restart.
Real licensed audio -> transcript revision -> corrected caption; revoke/UNKNOWN/restart.
Lawful voice -> real decoded audio; denied locale/profile/revoke.
Actual image/video geometry+track source PTS; malformed ROI.
Real STT/Vision+DI child -> grounded typed response; wrong clock/rights.
Real denoise/declip measured A/B with source preservation.
Real codec/frame repair and independent measured comparison.
Versioned brief/storyboard -> render -> review output.
Rights-checked conditioned output, continuity metrics and typed unavailability.
Real tracked ROI mask edit with precise version CAS and undo.
Deterministic 2D animation renders decodable frames and golden curves.
Rig/3D spatial render with coordinate/kinematic correctness.
Unit-correct dynamics and instrument values; solver negatives.
Executable constrained pass with semantic validity and abstention.
Actual translation+legal dubbing, lip/timing metadata and source rights.
Playable stems/foley/mix master with lawful input and peak caps.
Combined video+audio+caption+graphic color render with checksum.
Real quality metric and bounded optimization/reversible comparison.
Job pending/running/UNKNOWN/terminal across real process restart.
Immutable-review approval invalidated by changed source revision.
Actual export/publish destination ACK, lost-ACK reconciliation.
Encrypted offline edits, fresh-rights reconnect, version conflict handling.
Authenticated CLI JSON batch with true finality and typed failures.
Four agent handlers authorized delegate, no duplicate side effects.
Real revoke/hold/deletion and no post-erasure disclosure.
Unavailable/degraded/no-fallback/UNKNOWN behavior without fake success.
Real 360/spatial/interactive export and viewer fidelity.
Real media loss/reconnect/consent revoke and bounded stream recovery.
Real qualified model/voice/host readiness with unavailable cases.

criteria.library: source-free caller+actual decoded or deterministic output with bounds and adverse cases
criteria.feature: authenticated real transport, source+rights+version+durable finality/restart, relevant host consumer
criteria.devComplete: every applicable PDP feature and supported journey true positive/adverse, accurate config/docs and no fake admission

testReuse: Use existing scripts/local-test-pass-cache.mjs and scripts/check-media-surface-delivery.mjs; pass replay only when all source, environment, fixtures, tools and rights inputs unchanged; no --rerun-tasks by default.
